scope: Only planning documents and docs/post-mvp/mockups; no application verification or release gate run.

checks.description: 19 primary views × 4 sizes × normal and warnings states, with 23 synthetic students.

interactions.observed: Two recent notes are visible only for the populated profile; Altre note opens the remaining labelled notes on demand.
Selecting Mercoledì opens P13 directly with no intermediate dialog and preserves the selected day as page context.
Removing Luca B. from Sabato moves the row to Mai assegnati; tapping the name assigns Luca B. to Mercoledì. Full day names remain informational and the X is the explicit remove action.
Seven boats form two sticky rows at 320px, numbers 11/14/15 remain within their controls, and crew summaries use the Quest logo. Toggling a boat preserves the people.
The weekly summary precedes the day cards and is static. After scrolling to the end, the student subject remains at the top while the summary has left the viewport.
Course identity, scan counters, duty coverage, crew warnings, evaluation toggle and blank evaluation cells remain operational in the isolated mock.

limitations: Measurements describe synthetic layouts and primary interactive states, not every production state.
No physical-device, 200% text, contrast certification or production accessibility claim.
P17 deliberately uses more vertical space to keep full names and five direct evaluation controls visible.
No persistence, OCR accuracy, voice latency or cross-session integrity verification.
Human review of r4 is still required before its changed pages become implementation targets.
